review_text_raw: The writing and the acting are so amateur. I like FMV stuff, but this is too modern to be charming. There is this timed fail state that I am not sure if it was meant to be failed, then it makes you factory reset a fake phone and it asks you to enter personal stories... yeah, no. I'm not going to introspect on command for a 2 dollar college project. If Mario stopped you every 2 levels to deduce his last name or retraumatize yourself it would fucking suck, that's not art.

No, don't buy it

Instead of investigation, game offers you a chatting with two hysterical characters, and you actually, should build relationship with them, instead of finding missing girl, but game don't suggest it until the end, when it is too late.
Also it has frustrating timer moment that can't be replayed unless you start all game from beginning.
Nothing in this game is satisfying on any level - no real horror, no interesting puzzles to solve, despite the idea seemed interesting.
